entities.name: Topoisomerase VI subunit A
observations: The 366-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed Halobacterium salinarum UniProt B0R4D2 and Q9HR32 references (100% identity and coverage).
Annotated as ATP-hydrolyzing type II DNA topoisomerase; relaxes positive and negative DNA superturns and has strong decatenase activity.
Sequence annotations include ATP binding, DNA binding, magnesium-ion binding, DNA topological change, and DNA replication.
Reference GO cellular-component annotation is chromosome; no specific intracellular compartment is established by these data.
Pfam hits: TP6A_N (72–138), Topo_VI_alpha (142–191), and TOP6A-Spo11_Toprim (194–360).
